blocking_defects.title: Claimed pre-Torch isolation gate runs after project imports have already imported Torch
evidence: At 90ba042, mobile_scale_sweep.py imports barunlm.baselines.mobile_matched (which imports torch at module level) and barunlm.training.data (which imports torch at module level) before run() calls enforce_venv_isolation
scripts/run_mobile_scale_sweep.py runs pytest on the sweep suite then imports the runner module; both paths load Torch before the gate
Fresh subprocess: torch absent before runner import, present immediately afterward; flash_attn not auto-loaded by that import
blocking_defects.impact: INFRA-2's claim that isolation fails closed before Torch/CUDA import is false on the actual entrypoint. Native extensions and import-time side effects can execute before the gate emits evidence.
blocking_defects.required_fix_class: A distinct v6 must use a standard-library-only bootstrap that attests the environment before importing pytest, project modules, Torch, tokenizers, Transformers, or any native extension.

blocking_defects.title: Active virtual-environment attestation trusts a forgeable VIRTUAL_ENV path unbound to the executing interpreter
evidence: At 90ba042, enforce_venv_isolation reads os.environ['VIRTUAL_ENV'] (or a caller-supplied virtual_env) and <VIRTUAL_ENV>/pyvenv.cfg but never binds either to sys.executable or sys.prefix
It does not attest sys.path, site.ENABLE_USER_SITE, user-site, or PYTHONPATH
CPU tests accept a text-only synthetic directory containing pyvenv.cfg as an isolated active venv
blocking_defects.impact: A contaminated interpreter can point VIRTUAL_ENV at an unrelated clean pyvenv.cfg and satisfy the cfg half of the boundary. The returned virtual_env path is not evidence about the interpreter executing the runner.
blocking_defects.required_fix_class: V6 must bind the exact executable, sys.prefix/base_prefix, interpreter-owned pyvenv.cfg, normalized sys.path, user-site state, and PYTHONPATH before any project import.

blocking_defects.title: flash_attn probe classifies the exact attempt-4 ABI ImportError as safely absent
evidence: At 90ba042, probe_flash_attn_importable executes __import__('flash_attn') and treats every ImportError as False/unimportable

attempt-4 remote log shows the failure class is ImportError while importing flash_attn → flash_attn_interface → flash_attn_2_cuda (undefined symbol _ZN3c104cuda29c10_cuda_check_implementationEiPKcS2_ib)
Synthesized attempt-4-shaped package: probe returned False; combined with forged clean VIRTUAL_ENV, enforce_venv_isolation returned a passing receipt
blocking_defects.impact: The known attempt-4 hazard can be present on sys.path, raise ImportError during the probe, be recorded as flash_attn_importable=false, and still abort later inside Transformers.from_pretrained. Importing flash_attn to prove absence also executes package/native code during the check.
blocking_defects.required_fix_class: V6 must reject any visible flash_attn module/distribution/origin using a non-executing bootstrap-level inspection (e.g. find_spec / path enumeration) and must not import flash_attn to establish absence.
